title: HW↔DEVOPS-001: Device Provisioning + Production-Programming Hooks
description: Hardware supplies the programming/provisioning interface, board identifiers, production-programming hooks, and field-diagnostics access; DevOps provides device provisioning and enrollment, production-programming integration, and fleet onboarding. Grounded in DEVOPS_PLATFORM_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.7.

board_identifier_scheme.description: Board/unit identifier scheme used at enrollment.

injects_cryptographic_identity.description: True if provisioning injects device keys/certificates — a security-baseline touchpoint (ESC-SEC; governed by BACK↔SEC-001 / HW↔SEC-001).

sec_escalation_ref.description: Required when injects_cryptographic_identity = true: reference to the SEC review/approval (SIRC or ADR).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Mechanical provisioning/onboarding is agent-autonomous. If provisioning injects cryptographic device identity (keys/X.509 certificates), that is part of the mandatory security baseline and escalates to SEC (ESC-SEC, Tier-1) under HW↔SEC-001 / BACK↔SEC-001.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisioning-interface alignment at planning; production-programming setup before manufacturing; onboarding validation)
confirm_conditions: programming_interface declares interface_type, board_identifier_scheme, and ≥1 production_programming_hook
provisioning_flow defined and fleet_onboarding_validated before manufacturing
if injects_cryptographic_identity = true, a sec_escalation_ref is present
field-diagnostics access aligned with the debug-port lockdown policy (HW↔SEC-001)
reject_conditions: cryptographic-identity injection without a SEC review reference (ESC-SEC — security baseline)
field-diagnostics access that re-opens a locked debug port without SEC sign-off
production-programming setup finalized without a validated provisioning flow
counter_conditions: programming hook conflicts with the debug-port lockdown — request a joint HW/SEC review before manufacturing setup
board identifier scheme not unique at fleet scale — request a collision-safe scheme
